name: EST Token
fix_description: Remove the direct pair balance manipulation in _transfer: do not modify _tOwned[uniswapV2Pair] and call sync(). The delayed sell burn mechanism directly reduces pair token balance creating a desync between reserves and actual balance, enabling skim() exploitation. If deflation is needed, burn from the contract own balance instead.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC requires a non-trivial multi-step attack chain: flash loan funding, repeated deposits into a protocol-specific deposit contract, staged swaps, intentional state desynchronization by transferring EST to the deposit contract, and a 100-iteration skim loop exploiting Uniswap pair accounting. It also depends on understanding an EOA-only restriction bypass via EIP-7702-style delegation and how token/pair/deposit-contract balances interact, which is well beyond a straightforward pattern.
